package.name: sempath_planner
package.description: Closed-loop bridge between the SysNav scene-graph exporter and SemPathBench's GroundPlan method. Listens on /keyboard_input: "export" converts the freshly written dumps into a SemPathBench map (embedded checkout, map key real/<id>), "plan <instruction>" runs GroundPlan on it from the robot's current pose, "go" feeds the resulting waypoints to the local planner (/way_point + /speed + the Joy autonomy handshake), "stop" aborts. Publishes the planned path for RViz. Never touches scene-graph state.
